serverInfo.name: Simplicate-Workflows
serverInfo.title: Simplicate Workflows
serverInfo.description: Simplicate workflows: workflows, taken, acties en sjablonen raadplegen; workflows aanmaken, wijzigen, doorzetten, overdragen en verwijderen.

instructions: Read workflows and their lookup tables through resources/resource templates, not tools. Use the configured Simplicate organization and complete IDs returned by the API; never supply display names or add an assumed ID prefix. Lists default to only 5 results; paginate with limit and offset. Read /workflows/defaultworkflow before creating a workflow. The destination employee must be an active, unblocked user; a fixed first-task destination configured on the template takes precedence. Read the current workflow before executing an action: use actions[].id (a defaultaction ID), NOT a task ID. Supply a reaction when is_response_required is true. The optional next employee is subject to the destination task's settings. Transfer only when current_task.can_be_transferred allows it. Deadlines use yyyy-MM-dd, must not be before today, and deadline_step must not exceed deadline_workflow. Omitted update fields are preserved. Tools use primitive inputs and review/confirmation forms when supported; otherwise they execute directly. Attachment/comment mutations, bulk collection editing, template/task/action configuration mutations, and document uploads are not supported. Attachments and comments can still be read from workflow resources.
